flows:
Navigate to https://revoke.cash then Do not connect a wallet or sign anything.
On the Revoke.cash home page, click the search bar labelled with a placeholder like 'Search Accounts by Address or Domain', type the public address 'vitalik.eth', and press Enter.
Wait for the account page to load.
Never press 'Connect Wallet', 'Revoke', 'Revoke Selected' or any other button that changes approvals.
Assert that the page shows the searched account (the text 'vitalik.eth' or its 0x address) and that an approvals section with visible text such as 'Approvals' or 'Asset' is displayed.
